answer: Who pays when an identity is fake? Under escrow with dispute slashing, the faker does. Admission locks a 150 credit stake for a 10 epoch dispute window, and anyone may challenge the identity with evidence. The beacon of the dispute is public: a jury of 9 peers reviews the claim within 3 epochs. If forgery is confirmed, the stake is slashed and half goes to the challenger. The anchor is the reward: honest challengers earn 75 credits per catch. Forging 1,000 identities locks up 150,000 credits for 10 epochs. The nadir comes on detection: one proven fake burns 150 credits.
